subject: [PATCH v4 10/19] selftests/mm: add khugepaged completion barrier helper

reviews.author: Mike Rapoport
reviews.summary:
Reviewer Mike Rapoport requested that the patch description provide more explanation of the 'why' behind the changes, suggesting a better balance between describing what and how the code works versus explaining the underlying reasoning.

Reviewer Mike Rapoport questioned the need for a lengthy comment in the code, specifically pointing out that the function name already conveys that it only writes on change, and suggested removing the extraneous text.
reviews.raw_body:
This very much elaborates on "what" and "how" and very little on "why".
I'd change the balance.

---

Hmm, the function name already tells that it only writes on change.
Do we need this long text along with it?

Surely "khugepaged_full_pass() is ithe only sanctioned mode" is out of
line for infrastrucure helper description.

-- 
Sincerely yours,
Mike.

2026-08-20.patch_summary: This patch adds a completion barrier helper to the khugepaged selftest, allowing it to drive khugepaged in step and wait for full scans to advance by two. The helper uses sysfs settings to wake the daemon and complete the pass, ensuring that the whole mm list fits within a scan batch. Additionally, the patch updates thp_write_settings() to only write khugepaged knobs when their value changes, preventing unnecessary passes from starting.
